description: This PHP source file defines the class ImportFile, which handles processing and reading CSV import files in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for reading rows, detecting file properties, managing encoding, and handling header rows, and extends the ImportDataSource base class.

classes.name: ImportFile
classes.description: A class to handle processing an import CSV file, including reading data rows, detecting properties, managing encoding, and handling header rows. It extends ImportDataSource.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImportFile object by opening the specified file, setting delimiters, enclosure characters, and encoding detection.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the file and deletes it if configured to do so.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents deserialization of the object for security reasons.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks whether the file pointer is valid, indicating the file exists and is readable.

methods.name: getNextRow
methods.description: Reads the next row from the CSV file, handling delimiters, enclosures, and character encoding conversions.

methods.name: getFieldCount
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the current CSV row.

methods.name: getNumberOfLinesInfile
methods.description: Counts the total number of lines in the file.

methods.name: autoDetectCSVProperties
methods.description: Detects CSV delimiter and enclosure using CsvAutoDetect.

methods.name: getFieldDelimeter
methods.description: Returns the CSV delimiter.

methods.name: getFieldEnclosure
methods.description: Returns the CSV enclosure character.

methods.name: autoDetectCharacterSet
methods.description: Detects the character encoding of the file.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the detected date format from the CSV.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the detected time format from the CSV.

methods.name: setHeaderRow
methods.description: Sets whether the CSV file has a header row.

methods.name: hasHeaderRow
methods.description: Detects if the CSV has a header row, optionally auto-detects based on the file.

methods.name: setImportFileMap
methods.description: Sets import map properties from a provided map object.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current row index, as part of SPL Iterator implementation.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current CSV row, as part of SPL Iterator implementation.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next row, as part of SPL Iterator implementation.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current row is valid, as part of SPL Iterator implementation.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the file pointer and loads the first row, as part of SPL Iterator implementation.

methods.name: getTotalRecordCount
methods.description: Returns total number of records, accounting for header row if present.

methods.name: loadDataSet
methods.description: Loads a subset of data records into an internal dataset array.

methods.name: getHeaderColumns
methods.description: Returns header columns if present.
